name: @fsc/platform-workflows-release-toolchain
description: Pinned semantic-release toolchain for release.yaml and terraform-release.yaml. Not installed from this directory — the workflows read these pins with jq and pass them to npm install --no-save. It is a real package.json so Dependabot's npm ecosystem can watch and bump them; written inside a workflow's shell command they were invisible to it, and six of eight had silently drifted, one by a full major. conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits is held at 9.x on purpose: 10.x requires conventional-changelog-writer@9, while @semantic-release/release-notes-generator@14 pulls writer@8, and the mismatch kills the release at generateNotes. Do not take the 10.x bump until release-notes-generator@15 is out of beta.
